---
name: Alci hardware or emulator report
about: Tell us how an Alci image ran on your machine, whether it worked or not
title: 'Report: <machine> <image>'
labels: report
assignees: ''

---

Every report helps, including "it just worked". Leave out what you do not know.

**Image**
- Release and file (for example `alci-0.1-preview-fd720.img`):
- SHA-256 checked? (yes / no):
- How it was written (dd, rawrite, Greaseweazle, USB floppy drive, CF card...):

**Machine**
- Make and model, or emulator and version:
- CPU (8088, V20, 8086, 286, 386...) and clock:
- Memory (KB) and any EMS or extended memory:
- Video (MDA, Hercules, CGA, EGA, VGA, built-in LCD...):
- Floppy drives (360K, 720K, 1.2M, 1.44M) and hard disk or CF/XT-IDE:
- Network card, serial mouse, other hardware:

**Result**
- [ ] Boots to `login:`
- [ ] Login as `root` works
- [ ] Commands I tried worked (list them below)
- Where it stopped, if it did (last line on screen):
- Time from power-on to `login:` (a phone stopwatch is fine):

**Details**
Anything else: messages on screen (a photo is welcome), what you tried,
what was slow or fast, what you would like next.
